definitions.explanation: A parent and their child, or the relationship between them.

examples.japanese: {親子|おやこ}で{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: To participate as parent and child.

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{親子|おやこ}だ。{顔|かお}がそっくりだ。
examples.english: Those two are parent and child. They look just alike.

examples.japanese: {親子|おやこ}{丼|どん}は{鶏肉|とりにく}と{卵|たまご}を{使|つか}った{料理|りょうり}だ。
examples.english: Oyakodon is a dish made with chicken and egg.

notes:
{親子|おやこ} combines {親|おや} (parent) and {子|こ} (child).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {親子|おやこ}{丼|どん}: chicken-and-egg rice bowl (literally "parent-child bowl")
- {親子|おやこ}{関係|かんけい}: parent-child relationship
- {親子|おやこ}で: together as parent and child
- {親子|おやこ}{連|づ}れ: with one's child/children
